claimChecks.claim: Psoas hitch is itself a tubularized bladder flap and all variants always sacrifice reservoir capacity
claimChecks.locator: ACS ureter injury repair text; Bai Surgical procedure
claimChecks.note: Separated bladder mobilization/hitch from actual bladder-wall tubularized flap and scoped potential capacity impact.

claimChecks.claim: Boari flap is tubularized around the ureteral stump and requires submucosal anti-reflux tunneling
claimChecks.locator: Bai Surgical procedure paragraph four; prior documented refluxing-anastomosis scope
claimChecks.note: Ureter-to-flap apex anastomosis then tubularization over stent; anti-reflux tunnel optional in cited examples.

claimChecks.claim: Mauck 2011 reports Boari success 83% proximal and 88% distal
claimChecks.locator: PubMed abstract Results: 10/12 proximal received Boari and 10/17 distal; 17%/12% overall failure across 29 reconstructions
claimChecks.note: 83% is use rate, not success; 88% was complement of distal group failure, not separate Boari success.

claimChecks.claim: Manassero 91.6% represents the same success endpoint as ACS and Corse
claimChecks.locator: Manassero original abstract imaging in 22/24 and no reinterventions; Corse original abstract 45/50 success at median 15 months
claimChecks.note: Endpoint-specific outcomes now labeled rather than pooled; longer-term durability incomplete.

claimChecks.claim: Hardesty's 27.6% LUTS and 17% recurrent UTI apply to every bladder-flap technique
claimChecks.locator: PubMed original abstract Methods and Results
claimChecks.note: Scoped to 29 women after Boari flap at one institution, 18 also with hitch; 8 new LUTS, five recurrent UTI, two strictures.

claimChecks.claim: Bai 9/10 stent removal is 90% durable success for all full-length defects
claimChecks.locator: Abstract, Table 1, Results and Discussion, including one nephrectomy
claimChecks.note: Nine stents removed by six months, one later ipsilateral nephrectomy; seven full-length/three upper reported but baseline lengths and some follow-up descriptions inconsistent.

claimChecks.claim: Rotational VVF series yield pooled 88–94% guaranteed success and Patidar establishes broadly reliable outlet outcomes
claimChecks.note: Retained distinct small cohorts and exact denominators; no pooled estimate or generalized guarantee.

claimChecks.claim: All vascular, selection, technique, figure, endpoint and currency claims are fully verified
claimChecks.locator: Complete restored page versus prior gap inventory and bounded primary access
claimChecks.note: Most original technical full texts/figures and other domains remain unread; accessible guideline excerpt is trauma-specific.
